common_contracts.purpose: Represent long and short entries, reductions, exits, and reversals without converting short signals to HOLD.
fail_closed_rules: unsupported intent is rejected, never silently remapped
entry and exit authority remain simulation-only in authenticity stages

common_contracts.purpose: Preserve the strategy's original exit state instead of replacing it with a common fixed-R target.
fail_closed_rules: fixed profit target cannot substitute for an original channel, flip, session, or momentum exit
segment-end close is reported separately and cannot count as strategy-native performance

common_contracts.purpose: Persist deterministic strategy state required by prior-event, release, reversal, or pyramiding logic.
required_controls: state snapshot before and after each decision

common_contracts.purpose: Support strategies whose levels and resets depend on a previous exchange session.
fail_closed_rules: no rolling-window substitute for previous-session HLC
no current-session data leakage into frozen levels

common_contracts.purpose: Support strategy-native account-risk sizing and cross-market heat limits.
fail_closed_rules: fixed position fraction cannot impersonate N-based sizing
missing point value or equity blocks sizing
heat-limit breach blocks add and entry

common_contracts.purpose: Prevent unlike daily, session, event, and portfolio strategies from being forced through one generic replay horizon.
fail_closed_rules: forced segment close is prohibited as a native exit unless the source strategy specifies it

strategy_decisions.reason: The recursive Supertrend formula is already materially aligned; the smallest isolated repair is removal of synthetic pullback and fixed-target logic plus restoration of bidirectional flip entry and opposite-flip exit.
authentic_child_rules: retain formula-locked recursive final bands
enter long only on direction flip to long
enter short only on direction flip to short
exit or reverse only on opposite direction flip
remove EMA50 slope, swing, pullback, reclaim, candle filters, fixed targets, adds, reductions, and beam logic
record every direction transition and adapter intent without silent remapping
verification_order: cost stress only after gross-edge gate

authentic_child_rules: formula-lock Bollinger and Keltner variants
implement squeeze on and first-release state
implement Donchian-midpoint and SMA-delta linear-regression momentum histogram
separate momentum-direction entry from momentum-decay exit
remove fixed targets, chase filters, adds, reductions, and beam logic from baseline
freeze previous-session HLC before the current session
calculate all six ordered R-Breaker levels
require observation/setup excursion before reversal entry
arbitrate breakout and reversal modes in one session state machine
remove rolling 48-bar substitutes, EMA filters, fixed targets, adds, and chase logic
separate System 1 and System 2
persist previous-breakout result for the System 1 skip rule
implement 20-day and 55-day entries
implement N-based account-risk unit sizing
add equal units every 0.5N after favorable movement, maximum four
implement 2N stops per unit
implement 10-day and 20-day opposite-channel exits without fixed TP
enforce market-group and directional portfolio heat
never mix reversal and continuation trades
reversal child requires W-bottom or M-top geometry or independent confirmation plus return-inside-band confirmation
continuation child treats the initial outside close as continuation evidence with bandwidth expansion
both children expose percent-b, bandwidth, and regime diagnostics
remove water-add and common fixed-target substitution from authenticity baselines
